newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan stocks end up on new accounts buying.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan stocks end up on new accounts buying.

text.p: Pakistani stocks finished higher on Thursday amid new accounts buying of blue chips led by foreign demand, dealers said.
"Buying of select blue chips by foreign investors prompted locals to follow suit," a dealer at a foreign brokerage house said.
He said Hub Power's announcement about a problem with state utility pulled it down from the day's high of 41.40 rupees but could not dampen foreign interest.
The Karachi Stock Exchange 100-share index rose 16.18 points, or 1.03 percent, to close at 1,583.63 at 0903 GMT. Losers beat gainers 113 to 107.
Hub Power rose 0.60 to 40.95 rupees and Engro Chemicals 3.50 to 142.50.
